check-scope.js bewaakt dat elke policy controls heeft en alleen labels uit dit bestand gebruikt.
iso27001   ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A, Nederlandse titels volgens NEN-EN-ISO/IEC 27001:2023.
label       de exacte vorm in controls.iso.
titel       het titeldeel van label. Waar SPEC of het bestaande manifest een vorm voorschreef is
die aangehouden (titelBron spec/manifest), ook als die afwijkt van de NEN-tekst.
titelNen    de titel zoals in de Nederlandse norm; COMPLIANCE.md en de VvT tonen deze.
dekking     technisch | deels | organisatorisch — of de control met endpoint-/identitybeleid
(Intune, Conditional Access) af te dekken is. Organisatorisch betekent: niet met dat
beleid, dus proces, mensen, fysiek, of een ander technisch domein (netwerk, ontwikkeling).
soa         voorstel voor de verklaring van toepasselijkheid; 'afhankelijk' met reden.
nis2       Richtlijn (EU) 2022/2555 art. 21 lid 2 a–j; label exact zoals in SPEC.
cis        CIS Controls v8.1, safeguards van controls 1–14, 16 en 17; ig = laagste Implementation Group.
nistcsf    NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0, alleen de voor dit domein relevante subcategorieën.

controls.label: A.5.1 Beleidsregels voor informatiebeveiliging
controls.organisatorisch: Informatiebeveiligingsbeleid en onderwerpspecifiek beleid (o.a. endpoint-, toegangs- en AI-beleid) vaststellen, laten goedkeuren door het management en periodiek herzien.

controls.label: A.5.2 Rollen en verantwoordelijkheden bij informatiebeveiliging
controls.organisatorisch: Eigenaar van de baseline, CISO en beheerrollen (Intune-, Entra-, Defender-beheer) benoemen en vastleggen.

controls.label: A.5.3 Functiescheiding
controls.organisatorisch: Scheiding tussen wie policies wijzigt, wie ze goedkeurt (PR-review) en wie uitzonderingen verleent; Entra/Intune-RBAC en PIM inrichten — valt buiten deze baseline.

controls.label: A.5.4 Managementverantwoordelijkheden
controls.organisatorisch: Management stuurt aantoonbaar op naleving (NIS2 art. 20: bestuurders keuren maatregelen goed en volgen training).

controls.label: A.5.5 Contact met overheidsinstanties
controls.organisatorisch: Contactpunten met CSIRT/NCSC, toezichthouder en AP vastleggen, inclusief meldtermijnen.

controls.label: A.5.6 Contact met speciale belangengroepen
controls.organisatorisch: Deelname aan ISAC's, sectorale overleggen en leveranciersadviezen organiseren.

controls.label: A.5.7 Informatie en analyses over dreigingen
controls.organisatorisch: Dreigingsinformatie (Defender, Entra ID Protection, NCSC) laten beoordelen en vertalen naar aanpassingen van de baseline.

controls.label: A.5.8 Informatiebeveiliging in projectmanagement
controls.organisatorisch: Beveiligingseisen opnemen in projecten, bijvoorbeeld bij de uitrol van nieuwe apparaten of platformen.

controls.organisatorisch: Intune levert de apparaatinventaris; eigenaarschap, informatie-inventaris en periodieke controle op volledigheid zijn organisatorisch.

controls.label: A.5.10 Aanvaardbaar gebruik
controls.titelNen: Aanvaardbaar gebruik van informatie en andere gerelateerde bedrijfsmiddelen

controls.label: A.5.11 Retourneren van bedrijfsmiddelen

controls.label: A.5.12 Classificeren van informatie
controls.organisatorisch: Classificatieschema vaststellen; technische labels (Purview) vallen buiten deze baseline.

controls.label: A.5.13 Labelen van informatie
controls.organisatorisch: Labelprocedure en -hulpmiddelen (Purview-gevoeligheidslabels) — buiten deze baseline.

controls.label: A.5.14 Informatieoverdracht

controls.label: A.5.15 Toegangsbeveiliging
controls.organisatorisch: Toegangsbeleid vaststellen (wie mag waarbij, onder welke voorwaarden); Conditional Access en apparaatbeleid dwingen het af.

controls.label: A.5.16 Identiteitsbeheer
controls.organisatorisch: Levenscyclus van identiteiten (in-, door-, uitstroom) koppelen aan HR; gedeelde en serviceaccounts registreren.

controls.label: A.5.17 Authenticatie-informatie

subcategorieen.titel: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity are understood and managed
Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders
Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established and communicated
Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established, communicated, and enforced
Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced
Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy
A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program is established and agreed to
Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established and integrated into contracts
Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained
Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained
Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles
Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded
Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources
Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked
Improvements are identified from evaluations
Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed
Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions
Users, services, and hardware are authenticated
Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified
Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined, managed, enforced, and reviewed (least privilege, separation of duties)
Personnel are provided with awareness and training
The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected
The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected
The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected
Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested
Configuration management practices are established and applied
Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk
Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring
Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented
Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations
Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained
Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events
Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events
Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities
Information is correlated from multiple sources
Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools
The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared
Incident reports are triaged and validated
Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause
Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved
Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents
Incidents are contained
Incidents are eradicated
The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process
Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed
The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration
The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed
Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated stakeholders
